items.exampleEn: The big ship is going to Japan.
The bus driver is very nice.
We took a boat to the island.
A big truck is on the street.

items.exampleZh: 我可以騎你的腳踏車嗎？

items.exampleEn: I take the bus to school.

items.sentenceEn: The bus driver is my uncle.
items.sentenceZh: 那位公車司機是我叔叔。

items.audioEn: The train is too slow, so we will take the bus.
items.audioZh: 火車太慢了，所以我們會搭公車。

items.sentenceEn: We can go there by boat or by plane.
items.sentenceZh: 我們可以搭船或搭飛機去那裡。

items.sentenceEn: My father is a truck driver.

items.stemEn: The ____ drives the bus very carefully.
items.stemZh: 這位司機開公車開得很小心。

items.passageEn: Every day, Jack takes the bus to the station. Then he takes the train to the city. He works on a big ship. He cooks for the people on the ship. On the weekend, he takes his small boat out on the river.
items.passageZh: Jack 每天搭公車到車站，再搭火車進城。他在一艘大船上工作，幫船上的人煮飯。週末他會開著他的小船到河上。

referenceEn: I take the bus to the station.
I go to the station by bus.
rubricZh: 「搭公車」可用 take the bus、by bus 等

items.instructionZh: 用 ride 造一個句子，說說你會騎或搭的交通工具。
referenceEn: I ride my bike to work.
I ride the bus to school every day.
rubricZh: ride 後面接交通工具或動物（例如 ride a bike、ride the bus、ride a horse）
動詞配合主詞和時態（例如 I ride、I rode）
